value.name: Asha finishes eating soup
value.description: Asha completes her meal before leaving.

value.name: Rosa escorts Asha to the door
value.description: After Asha stands up, Rosa rises with her and walks her to the doorway.
evidence: At one-fifteen she stood up. Rosa stood up with her and walked her to the door.

value.name: Rosa praises Asha's work
value.description: Rosa tells Asha she did the job well and says most similar cases are handled badly.
evidence: "I have seen a number of these. Most of them are done badly. This one was done well."

value.name: Rosa says Asha will not return officially
value.description: Rosa tells Asha that once she leaves, she will not be coming back in any official capacity.
evidence: once you leave you are not coming back in any official capacity

value.name: Asha thanks Rosa
value.description: Asha responds appreciatively to Rosa's praise and farewell.

value.name: Rosa invites Asha back unofficially
value.description: Rosa asks whether Asha will return in an unofficial capacity, signaling continued personal connection.
evidence: "Will you come back in an unofficial capacity."

value.name: Asha accepts informal invitation
value.description: Asha says she would like to return if it would not be intrusive.
evidence: "I would like to," Asha said. "If it would not be an intrusion."

value.name: Rosa invites Asha to Sunday dinner
value.description: Rosa specifies that Asha should come for dinner the Sunday after next and bring nothing.
evidence: "Come for dinner some Sunday. Not next Sunday. The Sunday after."
"Six o'clock. Do not bring wine. Lucia has enough wine. Bring nothing. Bring yourself."
value.time_hint: The Sunday after next; six o'clock

value.name: Asha agrees to dinner invitation
value.description: Asha confirms she will come on the Sunday after next.

value.name: Asha leaves the house
value.description: Rosa opens the door and Asha steps out onto the stoop into the colder air.
evidence: Rosa opened the door. Asha stepped out onto the stoop. The cold air was sharper than it had been at ten-forty
